# Title 37 CFR fixtures (eCFR + annual)

Compact recipes for PATLAW-012.

* `ecfr_current_recipe.json` / `ecfr_historical_recipe.json` — eCFR unofficial presentation (cross-check only).
* `cfr_annual_recipe.json` — official GovInfo annual CFR package identity (separate from eCFR).
* `ecfr_failure_*.json` — typed pagination / retry / 429 / schema failures.
Prefer generators over bulk golden dumps.
